name: magic
description: Operator macros for Claude Code: refresh (context refresh), audit (scope/status audit), session (new-session handoff), think-deep (structured task orchestrator with per-step self-check + acceptance-gate loop), think (run manager over think-deep's protocol files), critic (blind-comparative acceptance-contract author), gauntlet (ready-to-paste build-to-a-bar prompt), explain (plain-language explanation), prompt (few-shot prompt generator + curator from a house prompt library), ruled (records the operator's rulings in their own words; quotes looked up in the session transcript; a stdlib checker for the lists), worklog (keeps a work log in a note: one step per request, the request quoted word for word; switched on per session, hooks carried by the skill). Stack-agnostic; pairs with the operator-macro block in guides/operator-macros.md.
